messages.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

The passages do not rank “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but they support the following SI-related capability set: transmission-channel validation; interface test with scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices; RefClk and PLL jitter performance using phase noise analyzers and signal generators; Power Distribution Network testing using scopes and network analyzers; ADC / DAC frontend performance using spectrum analyzers and signal generators; and high-speed PCB / PCBA SI flow covering insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning and transmission-line calculation [1][2][19].  
Wireless Communication context is supported only at a high level by raw source text listing “Wireless communication tester,” “Signal & spectrum analyzer,” and “Timing / Sync / Signal Integrity,” but the passages do not provide a ranked wireless-specific SI priority list [97][99].

NTN 頻譜與頻段 › TN / NTN coexistence
NTN 導入造成 RF layer interference 需重新檢視：

- satellite beam coverage 可能跨越國界與 terrestrial cell borders。
- NTN spectrum 可能與既有 terrestrial 5G bands 重疊或相鄰。
- 3GPP [[TR 38.863]] 研究 NTN 與 TN coexistence aspects。
- 量測與分析指標包含 [[ACIR]]、[[ACLR]]、[[ACS]]、[[PFD]]、[[EPFD]]、[[EEIRP]] 與 [[OBUE]]。

來源指出 [[PFD]] 用於描述衛星在地球表面任一點的 maximum allowable signal power，[[EPFD]] 用於描述多顆 satellites 對特定 receiver 的 aggregated interference power，[[EEIRP]] 則與 terrestrial base station upper 6 GHz 對 FSS 的保護相關。

- Slide 14 標題為 `R&S®VSE Signal analysis software`，描述為 PC analysis software。

  - Fast measurements with parallel analysis。
  - Supporting floating licenses。
  - Control multiple instruments from one PC。
- Slide 15 說 5G NR signal analysis 支援 presets for 5G NR Test models 與 support of all 5G NR measurements。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › SRS modes and configurations

- CMX supports all SRS modes：regular SRS、SRS antenna switching、SRS carrier switching。
- CMX supports all SRS configurations，例如 1T2R、1T4R、2T4R（2 SRS sent at a time on 4 antennas overall）。
- Specific SRS measurements 包含 TX Power、EVM and more。
- Scheduling is automatically adapted。
- Measurement is aware of the SRS positions。
- 使用者可 select the SRS resource to measure。

依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，[[3GPP TS 38.214]] 中的 xTyR 表示：同一時間 UE 以 Y 個 antennas 中的 X 個 antennas 同時傳送某個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs；另一時間再以其他 X 個 antennas 傳送另一個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs。來源列出的 configurations 包含 1T2R、2T4R、1T4R、1T4R/2T4R、1T=1R、2T=2R、4T=4R。

NTN 頻譜與頻段 › 3GPP NTN frequency range 定義
依 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]]，3GPP 在 NTN 中使用下列分類：

| 分類 | 頻率範圍 | 說明 |
|---|---:|---|
| FR1 | 410 MHz to 7.125 GHz | 一般 5G NR FR1，來源指出 2026 年初有討論延伸到 8 GHz。 |
| FR2 | 24.250 GHz to 71 GHz | 一般 5G NR FR2，Rel. 17 已從原本 52.6 GHz 擴展。 |
| FR1-NTN | 410 MHz to 14500 MHz | 出自 [[TS 38.101-5]]；可包含 Ku-band 中部分頻率，因此與 FR2-NTN 有重疊。 |
| FR2-NTN | 10700 MHz to 30000 MHz | 出自 [[TS 38.101-5]]；用於 NTN FR2 / Ku / Ka 等場景。 |

FR1-NTN 與 FR2-NTN 有重疊，原因是 Ku-band 10 GHz 到 15 GHz 可套用 FR1 numerologies 或 FR2 numerologies。來源指出，在 3GPP specification 中，FR1-NTN 被視為 FR1，FR2-NTN 被視為 FR2 region。

R&S FSWX › 產品定位與架構
- 產品定位：multiport signal and spectrum analyzer。

- 可用於 spectrum、noise measurement、phase noise、modulation quality（EVM）的 [[Cross-correlation]]。

- 可在 high-power carrier 存在時量測 distortion 與 noise。
- 可針對 EVM 要求嚴苛的 components 做 characterization。
- Multipath wideband phase coherent receivers 可使用 independent receivers 同時進行 signal analysis 與 spectrum analysis。
- 可在 spectrum 任意位置、相同或不同頻率同時觀察 signals。
- 可同時量測 antenna 的 H 或 V polarizations、device input 與 output，並直接比較 ports 之間的 amplitude、frequency、phase。

answer.text:
The passages do not rank “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but they support the following SI-related capability set: transmission-channel validation; interface test with scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices; RefClk and PLL jitter performance using phase noise analyzers and signal generators; Power Distribution Network testing using scopes and network analyzers; ADC / DAC frontend performance using spectrum analyzers and signal generators; and high-speed PCB / PCBA SI flow covering insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning and transmission-line calculation [1][2][19].  
Wireless Communication context is supported only at a high level by raw source text listing “Wireless communication tester,” “Signal & spectrum analyzer,” and “Timing / Sync / Signal Integrity,” but the passages do not provide a ranked wireless-specific SI priority list [97][99].
